description: Land Title Settlement Department - Enamaluwa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310009
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
